meta.title: 新手进阶指南！手把手教你用稳定器
meta.title_en: Advanced Beginner's Guide: Master Your Gimbal

scenes.context: 全域跟随是稳定器新手最头疼但效果最出彩的模式，三轴同时跟随运动。
sentences: 全域跟随是稳定器新手最头疼但效果最出彩的模式。
All-axis follow is the most daunting gimbal mode for beginners—and the most impressive.
all-axis follow（全域跟随）
三轴同时跟随运动，可进行更大范围、多角度、甚至360度旋转的运动。
All three axes follow at once, allowing wide, multi-angle, even 360-degree moves.
360-degree rotation（360度旋转）
这个模式最适合拍摄慢门镜头、创作类画面。
It's ideal for slow-shutter shots and creative footage.
slow-shutter（慢门镜头）
配合云台零延迟设置，画面极具张力和冲击力。
With zero-lag settings, frames gain real tension and impact.
tension and impact（张力冲击力）
scenes.speak: All-axis follow is the most daunting gimbal mode for beginners—and the most impressive. All three axes follow at once, allowing wide, multi-angle, even 360-degree moves. It's ideal for slow-shutter shots and creative footage. With zero-lag settings, frames gain real tension and impact.

scenes.context: 平移、俯仰三轴同时跟随，可手动切换为360度旋转自定义模式。
sentences: 平移、俯仰三轴同时跟随。
Pan and tilt axes follow simultaneously.
three axes（三轴同时）
可手动切换为360度旋转自定义模式。
You can switch to a manual 360-degree rotation mode.
custom mode（自定义模式）
稳定器可以更大幅度、多角度运动。
The gimbal can move wider and at more angles.
wider moves（更大幅度）
全域跟随是你用得最少但最值得练习的模式，它决定了你画面的上限。
You use it least, but it sets the ceiling of your footage.
the ceiling of your footage（画面的上限）
scenes.speak: Pan and tilt axes follow simultaneously. You can switch to a manual 360-degree rotation mode. The gimbal can move wider and at more angles. You use it least, but it sets the ceiling of your footage.

scenes.context: 加长了俯仰轴臂，解决了安装滤镜后碰到横滚轴的问题。
sentences: 加长了俯仰轴臂，解决了装滤镜后碰到横滚轴的问题。
The extended tilt arm stops filters from hitting the roll axis.
extended tilt arm（加长俯仰轴臂）
全域模式下安装滤镜不再受限。
Filters no longer get blocked in all-axis mode.
filters unrestricted（滤镜不受限）
paraphrase: extended tilt arm（加长俯仰轴臂
extended tilt arm（加长俯仰轴臂
scenes.speak: The extended tilt arm stops filters from hitting the roll axis. Filters no longer get blocked in all-axis mode.

scenes.context: 先小范围练习再逐步扩大运动幅度，不要一上来就用全域跟随。
sentences: 先熟练掌握锁定和平移跟随，再尝试全域跟随。
Master lock and pan-follow first, then try all-axis.
master the basics first（先掌握基础）
先小范围练习，再逐步扩大运动幅度。
Practice small movements first, then widen the range.
start small（小范围练习）
不要一上来就用全域跟随。
Don't jump straight into all-axis mode.
don't jump in（不要一上来就用）
全域模式下运动幅度大，注意脚步稳定和身体平衡。
With big movements, watch your footing and balance.
footing and balance（脚步与平衡）
paraphrase: don't jump in（不要一上来就用
don't jump in（不要一上来就用
scenes.speak: Master lock and pan-follow first, then try all-axis. Practice small movements first, then widen the range. Don't jump straight into all-axis mode. With big movements, watch your footing and balance.

scenes.context: 适合创作类慢门镜头、旋转视角特效、需要画面冲击力的场景。
sentences: 适合创作类慢门镜头、旋转视角特效、需要画面冲击力的场景。
It suits creative slow-shutter shots, rotating POV effects, and high-impact scenes.
creative slow-shutter（创作类慢门）
新手日常跟拍、需要稳定构图的固定线路拍摄，则用简单模式。
Daily follow shots and fixed-route framing use the simpler modes.
simple modes（简单模式）
能熟练使用全域跟随，意味着你已经真正掌握了稳定器。
Fluency in all-axis mode means you've truly mastered the gimbal.
truly mastered（真正掌握）
scenes.speak: It suits creative slow-shutter shots, rotating POV effects, and high-impact scenes. Daily follow shots and fixed-route framing use the simpler modes. Fluency in all-axis mode means you've truly mastered the gimbal.

practice: All three axes follow; great for creative shots.
You can switch to a manual 360-degree mode.
The extended tilt arm frees filter mounting.
Master lock and PF first, then widen the range.
Fluency in all-axis sets your footage's ceiling.
pitfalls: Big moves need stable steps and balance.
Mount filters that hit the axis.
shifts: 用 all-axis follow（全域跟随）、pan-follow（平移跟随）、lock mode（锁定模式）
用 360-degree rotation（360度旋转）、slow-shutter shot（慢门镜头）、tension and impact（张力冲击力）
用 start small（小范围练习）、zero-lag settings（零延迟设置）、the ceiling of your footage（画面上限）
